title: Bethesda Terrace Fountain in Central Park, 1950s NYC B&W Snapshot Photo
location: Central Park, Manhattan, New York, United States
description: A vintage square format snapshot overlooking the Bethesda Fountain and plaza in Central Park, Manhattan. Taken from the upper level of Bethesda Terrace, an ornamental carved stone balustrade and decorative urn occupy the left foreground, framing the iconic Angel of the Waters fountain, the lake, and surrounding summer trees. Printed with classic mid-century deckled scalloped edges, this image captures a timeless perspective of New York City's most famous urban oasis.
